course.title: Unit 4 Then and now-Part C--【例句】

sentences.content: I had a race with my father and Max. I couldn’t run fast.
sentences.english: I had a race with my father and Max . I couldn't run fast
sentences.chinese: 我和父亲以及Max进行了一场赛跑。我跑不快。

sentences.content: Robin gave me some water. I drank it and could run fast again.
sentences.english: Robin gave me some water . I drank it and could run fast again
sentences.chinese: Robin给了我一些水。我喝了之后又能跑得很快了。

sentences.content: I ran like a cheetah. But suddenly I tripped and fell.
sentences.english: I ran like a cheetah . But suddenly I tripped and fell
sentences.chinese: 我像猎豹一样飞奔。但突然被绊倒了。

sentences.content: Cavemen often ate raw meat. They didn’t cook their food.
sentences.english: Cavemen often ate raw meat . They didn't cook their food
sentences.chinese: 穴居人经常生食肉类，他们并不烹饪食物。

wordDetails.definition: do（过去式，否定）: 构成否定

sentences.content: Now there are many things to help you cook.
sentences.english: Now there are many things to help you cook
sentences.chinese: 如今有许多东西能帮你下厨。

sentences.content: In 2050, there will be house robots. They will cook, clean and wash the dishes.
sentences.english: In 2050 , there will be house robots . They will cook , clean and wash the dishes
sentences.chinese: 到2050年，将会出现家用机器人。它们能做饭、打扫卫生和洗碗。

sentences.content: Before humans lived on the earth, whales already lived in the sea.
sentences.english: Before humans lived on the earth , whales already lived in the sea
sentences.chinese: 在人类居住在地球上之前，鲸鱼早已生活在海洋中。

sentences.content: We should help the earth now, so birds will have homes.
sentences.english: We should help the earth now , so birds will have homes
sentences.chinese: 我们现在就应该帮助地球，这样鸟儿们才会有家。
